_meta.note: Baseline ESTIMATOR & OPERATIONAL hazards — distinct from data-quality (baseline-dq-rules.json). Even with perfect input data, the robust+adaptive statistic and the runtime that serves it can corrupt or mislead. Each: detect → mitigation → effect → confidence impact. Surfaced by an adversarial numerical-methods + reliability critic. The two SAFETY rules are the highest-stakes: personalization must never normalise a pathological value or silently track a slow deterioration. Illustrative; re-verify (README §5.6).

rules.name: MAD = 0 → σ collapse / z = ∞
rules.detect: MAD == 0 or σ_robust < floor while n_effective non-trivial (≥50% identical values, quantised metrics)
rules.action: metric-specific σ floor = max(σ_robust, quantization step, physiological min-spread); else fall back to cohort σ; never emit a zero-width band; cap |z|
rules.effect: stops a razor-thin band making every reading look anomalous
rules.conf: low when spread came from a floor, not real dispersion

rules.name: MAD/median unstable & biased low at small n
rules.detect: n_effective < ~7 valid days, or MAD from < 5 residuals; large σ jump between recomputes
rules.action: below threshold widen via cohort-pooled scale + shrink personal weight; apply small-sample correction to the 1.4826 constant; require min-n before personal σ
rules.effect: stops over-tight bands & false deviations on new users
rules.conf: scale confidence with n_effective, don't saturate early

rules.name: Even-count median & window-edge churn
rules.detect: median value oscillates as one sample enters/leaves the 28-day edge; inconsistent even-count median convention
rules.action: pin one median convention; hysteresis/debounce on the boundary; prefer continuous recency-weighting over a hard cutoff
rules.effect: stops μ stepping day-to-day under stable physiology (phantom drift)
rules.conf: flag jitter to avoid false 'stable' confidence

rules.name: EWMA initialisation/seed bias
rules.detect: early-life baseline still dominated by its seed (first value / cohort seed)
rules.action: seed from cohort prior + bias-correct by 1−(1−α)^t (Adam-style); blend in median until EWMA warms up
rules.effect: stops day-1's value anchoring μ for many days

rules.name: Fixed-α EWMA wrong under gapped sampling
rules.detect: inter-update Δt varies (gaps, multi-reading days) yet a fixed per-update α is applied
rules.action: time-aware EWMA: α_t = 1 − exp(−Δt/τ) so weight decays by elapsed time, not update count; reconcile same-day readings before updating
rules.effect: stops μ becoming path/sampling-dependent (half-life is in days, not updates)
rules.conf: reflect realised Δt coverage, not nominal half-life

rules.name: Personal μ with cohort σ (scale mismatch)
rules.detect: z where μ provenance (personal) ≠ σ provenance (cohort) during the blend
rules.action: compose variance from both sources; inflate σ_effective for the mismatch; never pair personal centre with cohort spread untagged
rules.effect: stops mis-scaled z/band during shrinkage
rules.conf: encode that centre & spread are from different populations

rules.name: Cohort→personal handover discontinuity
rules.detect: step in μ/σ at the n-threshold where the blend weight switches regime
rules.action: continuous shrinkage weight w(n)=n/(n+κ) for BOTH μ and σ; avoid double-counting the prior once personal data also pulls toward cohort
rules.effect: stops a burst of false deviations on the crossover day
rules.conf: must not jump at the crossover

rules.name: No cohort prior for a rare demographic
rules.detect: empty/under-populated age×sex×life-stage cell (pregnancy, very old, intersex, pediatric, sparse intersections)
rules.action: hierarchical back-off to a coarser cohort with widened σ; never use a zero/global prior silently; surface 'no reliable prior' + conservative wide bands
rules.effect: stops mis-centring exactly the least-represented users

rules.name: ±kσ band wrong for skewed/one-sided metrics
rules.detect: skewed residuals or bounded metrics (SpO₂ ≤100, steps ≥0, HRV right-skew, one-directional deviation)
rules.action: asymmetric/quantile bands or log/Box-Cox transform; robust skew (medcouple) for k_low≠k_high; one-sided deviation logic for one-sided metrics
rules.effect: stops the upper bound exceeding a physiological ceiling & flagging the wrong tail

rules.name: z-capping hides true severity
rules.detect: z clamped to ±z_max for display; sustained clamping of a genuinely large/worsening deviation
rules.action: clip only the visual band; keep raw z internally; emit a 'beyond-scale' flag + uncapped magnitude to the alert/clinical layer
rules.effect: stops a z=12 event looking identical to a z=4 event

rules.name: k in μ±kσ not coverage-calibrated
rules.detect: empirical fraction of in-control readings inside μ±kσ ≠ nominal coverage
rules.action: calibrate k per metric from observed residuals (don't assume Gaussian); recalibrate periodically; report achieved coverage
rules.effect: stops systematically too-wide/narrow bands & mis-set deviation rates

rules.name: Spurious drift from autocorrelation
rules.detect: slope CI ignores AR(1) structure; slope driven by < N independent points
rules.action: AR-corrected slope SE (prewhiten / block bootstrap); robust Theil-Sen slope; require slope to exceed an autocorrelation-inflated bar
rules.effect: stops frequent spurious 'drift detected' on serially-correlated daily data
rules.conf: deflate drift confidence for effective (not nominal) DOF

rules.name: Step-change reported as gradual drift
rules.detect: changepoint detector fires inside the window (device change, med start) producing a slope artifact
rules.action: decompose level-shift vs trend; if a changepoint dominates, report a step + re-segment rather than a slope
rules.effect: stops one step bleeding into a multi-day slope and distorting μ
rules.conf: lower drift confidence when a changepoint co-occurs

rules.name: Cancellation / overflow in online stats
rules.detect: naive Σx²−(Σx)²/n paths, large cumulative sums, large-offset low-spread metrics (Kelvin temps, big step totals)
rules.action: Welford/Kahan-compensated updates; store residuals not raw sums of squares; 64-bit / periodic re-base for cumulative sums; periodic batch-recompute check
rules.effect: stops negative/zero or wildly-off variance & overflow-corrupted baselines

rules.name: Winsorization limits mis-set
rules.detect: winsor caps derived from the same contaminated σ they protect (circular), or fixed caps clipping real extremes; high winsorized fraction
rules.action: set limits from a robust pre-estimate (median ± c·MAD) computed before EWMA; bound the winsorized fraction; coordinate with athletic-extreme protection
rules.effect: stops outliers leaking through OR real signal being clipped & σ shrinking artificially

rules.name: Confidence decay depends on eval clock
rules.detect: confidence/staleness computed from server 'now' varies by recompute time / worker clock / timezone; same baseline yields different confidence at different read times
rules.action: define Δt from a canonical event timeline + one authoritative clock; make confidence a pure function of data; guard against negative Δt from skew
rules.effect: stops the score being non-reproducible / time-of-eval-dependent

rules.name: Silent staleness on recompute-job failure
rules.detect: last_successful_recompute age vs SLA; serving a baseline with un-incorporated new events
rules.action: expose baseline freshness; degrade confidence / refuse to flag deviations past a staleness threshold; idempotent retry + dead-letter; never serve stale μ/σ as current
rules.effect: stops scoring deviations against an outdated μ while real change goes unmodelled

rules.name: Two recomputes of same data disagree
rules.detect: recompute twice from identical raw → μ/σ/slope differ (unordered aggregation, float reduction order, median tie-break)
rules.action: deterministic input ordering + fixed/compensated reduction; canonical tie-breaks; pin algo + library versions; checksum outputs in CI
rules.effect: stops the same user seeing different bands on different runs

rules.name: Algorithm version change shifts all baselines
rules.detect: a deploy changes estimator params (window, half-life, k, winsor, 1.4826 handling) without versioning; population-wide step in deviation rate post-release
rules.action: version the algorithm + store algo_version per baseline; migrate via shadow/A-B with a calibration check; grandfather existing baselines; alert on population deviation-rate shift
rules.effect: stops an unversioned change mass-generating/suppressing deviations system-wide

rules.name: Backfill/deletion recompute storm
rules.detect: late-arriving/edited/deleted history fans out into mass recomputes; recompute queue depth & cost spike
rules.action: incremental windowed recompute bounded to the affected window; debounce/coalesce triggers; rate-limit fan-out; cache immutable partial aggregates
rules.effect: stops latency/cost blow-ups that delay fresh baselines (compounds staleness)
rules.conf: indirect via staleness during the storm

rules.name: False-alarm inflation across many metrics
rules.detect: ~dozens of simultaneous z-tests per user/day; alert volume inconsistent with per-test α
rules.action: multiple-comparison control (FDR / per-user daily alert budget); require corroboration or k-consecutive-day persistence before flagging
rules.effect: stops several chance false deviations per user per day eroding trust

rules.name: Baseline normalises a pathological-but-stable value
rules.detect: personal μ sits in a clinically abnormal range though personally stable (chronically high resting HR / low SpO₂ / high BP)
rules.action: DUAL-TRACK — personal-relative z AND absolute clinical guardrails; surface 'your normal is outside the population-healthy range'; personalization must never suppress an absolute red-flag (Doc 05 early-warning)
rules.effect: stops a chronically hypertensive/hypoxic user never triggering despite a dangerous absolute level

rules.name: Adaptive baseline hides slow deterioration
rules.detect: sustained one-directional drift the short window keeps absorbing; cumulative change vs a long-horizon (90–180d / onboarding) anchor exceeds a clinical bound
rules.action: keep a slow/frozen reference beside the 28-day adaptive one; alert on cumulative directional change even if each day is in-band; cap how fast the baseline may follow a monotone trend
rules.effect: stops the band tracking a genuine decline so the user never sees a deviation while truly worsening
